title: The Empty Verdict Again
author: Felix Voss
blurb: Sable Amberdale, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
